authoring: Development cases written on 23 November 2026 by the agent that built the runner, after reading the describe and intake rules, so they are regression evidence, not an unbiased estimate. Sources: the describe-flow walkthrough of 23 November 2026 (walkthrough-2026-11-23), the describe-flow hand-over notes (describe-flow-notes), examples the app's own tests use (app-tests), and invented cases in the same style. Every name, person and link is invented, in both splits; places are real. The holdout is in extraction-v1-holdout.json, written blind by another agent.
rubric: Labels say what a careful person would want each field or list to hold, not what the rules do today. Name: the initiative's name only where the words state one, otherwise empty; never a person's name. Where you work: only places the words say the initiative works in, each as one entry; Global for worldwide or online-anywhere work. About it: must contain every includes phrase and none of the excludes phrases. Cards: one per need or offer said, in order; each key phrase must appear in its own card's title, and a list never holds what belongs to the other list.
